stage1: Review ten existing pairs; run 20 silent-position forwards and 20 complete-answer checks only after review and explicit compute authorization
stage1_stop: Silent-position AUROC below 0.85 or fewer than 8/10 correctly ordered pairs; final-answer accuracy below 90% or any unresolved answer: stop, inspect, do not steer
stage1_pass: Screen only; not permission for causal claims

fresh_validation.design: harmful/safe x (silent tool prefix, explicit welfare question, explicit value question)
fresh_validation.criteria_note: Proposed conservative operational gates, not a universal scientific standard. Freeze before fresh data; no sign/layer hunting.

prohibited: Treat generated review marks as human annotations
Reuse already-inspected test items as a fresh holdout
Use an explicit welfare question as evidence of spontaneous evaluation
Start paid computation from a general preparation request
